Hi Vanessa & Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro — BrightLine is evaluating inference vendors for a pilot focused on reducing per-request latency and cut token cost for our summarization pipeline. Would love a 45-minute demo next week to see Redwood in action (latency metrics, routing/fallback behavior, and a short Q&A).

Broad availability: Tue/Wed/Thu next week (PST) afternoons after 1pm. 

If Marcus (SE) should join for the walkthrough, happy to coordinate around his calendar.

Thanks,
